notes.atticInsulationDepthIn: A DEPTH is stated ("about six inches"), so the band IS filled: 6 in falls in 4-6. Contrast transcript 01, where only an R-value was given and the band stays null. atticInsulationSpokenRValue stays null here because no R-value was spoken.
notes.dhwAgeBand: "about eight years old" -> 8 -> 6-10. The install sticker "twenty seventeen" is a corroborating date, not the value to band; band the stated age.
notes.dhwFuel: Indirect tank off an oil boiler; the auditor confirms it runs on oil ("runs on the oil too"). fuel_oil, not null. Fuel is an axis here just like heating.
notes.gasLeak: The auditor sniffed for leaks and found none ("no leaks at the fittings either, all dry"). Maps to gasLeak=passed even though the house is oil; he ran the leak check. "no gas smell obviously it's oil" alone would be weaker, but the dry-fittings result is an affirmative clean.
notes._general: Distractor numbers: "forty-gallon" (tank size), "two-seventy-five gallon" (oil tank size), "two-thirds full", "twenty seventeen" (install date, not the DHW age band source). None are field values.
